summary: All 4 targeted fixes verified. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass covering (1) UK-time calendar (today+future accepted, past rejected 400, delete author-only 403 for partner), (2) media upload for PNG image, animated GIF (.gif preserved), and MP4 video with retrieval via /api/files/{path}, (3) read-receipt Sent -> Delivered (after partner GET /messages) -> Read (after POST /messages/read) transitions, (4) POST /api/register-push endpoint wired and responds (201 or 5xx acceptable due to placeholder key; endpoint present, no crash). Regression: couples create/join/me, chat text, moods, worries+comments, gallery all pass. Frontend smoke: Expo web preview at EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL loads onboarding, create-space navigates to home showing UK 'together since' date, chat send shows 'Sent' read-receipt via testID=read-receipt-{id}, calendar tab renders with add-event-btn. No deprecated Expo packages (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch). No React Native red screen, no console pageerrors.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 800-line file — consider splitting into routers (couples, messages, events, moods, worries) as it grows past MVP.
send_media accepts any file extension and falls back silently; consider explicit 415 for unsupported types instead of coercing to jpg/mp4.

get_object/put_object use blocking `requests` inside async endpoints — currently wrapped in run_in_threadpool for uploads only; the GET /files path in download_file already uses run_in_threadpool so this is fine, just worth noting.
seed_data_creation: Fresh TEST_Alex/TEST_Masha couple created per session via /api/couples/create + /api/couples/join. Test data prefixed with TEST_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Reusable pytest suite lives in /app/backend/tests/. The session-scoped `couple_pair` fixture in conftest.py sets up Alex+Masha and returns (alex_id, masha_id, couple_id, code). BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Media upload is testable via the /api/messages/media endpoint (multipart) — the native file-picker path in the app cannot be exercised via web preview, so trust the backend contract. Read-receipt transitions are asserted independently on the same message id: after Masha's first GET /messages the partner's message gains delivered_at, after POST /messages/read {through_id} it gains read_at.
